name: Elmpaw's Head

angles.text: As a hunter, you know the skill it takes to bring down a formidable beast like Elmpaw and claim its trophy.

faq.answer: Elmpaw is a formidable creature, and hunters regard bringing it down as an impressive feat. Its head proves the victory.
The handler wants Elmpaw’s head to prepare and mount as a trophy for wealthy collectors who display such prizes on their mantles.
faq.q: Why does the quest giver want Elmpaw's head?

faq.answer: The collectors are wealthy patrons who value exotic beast trophies for their homes. Once mounted, Elmpaw’s head can fetch a high price.
faq.q: Who are the collectors interested in the trophy?

faq.answer: Elmpaw is a notable challenge, and hunters regard bringing the beast down as an impressive feat.
You hunt Elmpaw in the wild and bring its head to an interested handler. The handler rewards you and prepares the trophy for sale.
faq.q: What kind of task is Elmpaw's Head?

faq.answer: Elmpaw roams wilderness where hunters encounter dangerous beasts. After the hunt, bring its head back to the handler.

sections.body: Elmpaw has fallen, and hunters prize the beast’s head as proof of victory. Trackers regard the hunt as an impressive feat, a hard-won end to the chase.
sections.title: The Fallen Beast

sections.body: A handler rewards you for Elmpaw’s severed head. Then the handler prepares and mounts it for wealthy patrons who want fierce wild trophies on their mantles.
sections.title: A Collector's Prize

summary: At Elmpaw's Head, the hunt is over, and a wealthy collector awaits its prize. The beast’s head goes to a handler who prepares and mounts trophies for affluent patrons.
